test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase** "fond of"** means having a liking or affection for something, which aligns with the context where L. M. Thapar is described as enjoying a good life.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4: fond of**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"He was** fond of** a good life and was known for being charming and polished."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **A: "want of" **– This option is incorrect because it implies lacking, not enjoying.
 
• **B: "caring for"** – This option suggests taking care, which is not fitting in this context.
 
• **C: "world of"** – This phrase does not fit grammatically in the sentence.
